envfiles.title: .env file
envfiles.body: Versions of this file, newest first. Values show only after you enter your password.

pull.unchanged: No change since the last version.

noPath.title: No .env file set
noPath.body: Set the path of the server's .env file under Settings on Overview.

empty.title: No versions yet
empty.body: Pull the file from the server to keep its first version.

reveal.label: File content
reveal.copyUnavailable: Copying is not available here. Select the content and copy it.

prompt.title: Show values
prompt.body: Enter your password to show the values of this version.

compare.title: Changes since the previous version
compare.none: No difference in keys or values.
compare.first: This is the first version kept.

push.action: Push this version to the server
push.confirmTitle: Replace the .env file on the server?
push.confirmBody: The file on the server now is kept as a version first. Then this version takes its place.

prompt.title: Push this version
prompt.body: Enter your password to replace the .env file on the server with this version.
